layouts.notes: headline = short statement, set in upper case. text line 1 = attribution under the statement. note = footer line beside the book mark. The hero object is the book cover art, or a Design Bank asset if design_bank_asset_id is set.

notes: The only square template. Book cover as hero object on an accent-coloured ground with an oversized light-weight statement. Intended for the occasional book-discovery post (cta_intent discover_book) or a bold one-line statement. Ground colour is the accent; if neither ink nor white reaches 4.5:1 on it, the accent tint is used instead.
